expectation.stresses: Class-based DSC resources that inherit from a base class in another module, reached through a using module chain more than one deep. Inheritance that crosses a module boundary.
expectation.predicted: Succeeds. Classes appear as nodes but their base types do not, because the base is defined in a module that is never followed; the inheritance edge is dropped rather than reported as unresolved. The using module statements appear as unresolved module references, which is the one place the chain is visible.
